sources.fullCitation: “The Duchess Has a Twinkle in Her Eye.” Stage performance attributed to Christoph Wagner-Trenkwitz with Ensemble Albero Verde, in Die letzte Nacht at Theater und Kabarett “Die Hölle”, Theater an der Wien, 2014. Video published by jerzabinka on YouTube, 29 March 2019.

sources.researchNote: The video shows a staged live performance, not a historical film excerpt or an audio-only upload. Its description names Christoph Wagner-Trenkwitz and Ensemble Albero Verde and dates the production to 2014; those performance details are uploader-supplied. The structured date is the YouTube publication date, not the performance year or the 1935 date of the song’s film context, Kind Lady. The earlier claim that the upload did not identify the performers was incorrect. No new People records are created for this one-off modern performance.

media.title: The Duchess Has a Twinkle in Her Eye — modern stage performance
media.description: Video of a modern stage performance of “The Duchess Has a Twinkle in Her Eye”. The uploader identifies Christoph Wagner-Trenkwitz with Ensemble Albero Verde in Die letzte Nacht at Theater und Kabarett “Die Hölle”, Theater an der Wien, and dates the production to 2014. This is not footage from Kind Lady (1935).
